capabilities: export tags with their file paths to a JSON file
export per-note metadata including frontmatter, tags, links and backlinks to JSON
export a list of folders and non-Markdown files to JSON
export canvas file metadata to JSON
schedule exports or write files on launch and set output paths
extras: Scheduled export is disabled by default (frequency 0) and writing on launch defaults to false; JSON files are saved to the plugin folder unless absolute paths are configured.
motivation: To enable third-party apps to access Obsidian metadata which they normally cannot reach, exemplified by launcher apps and graph analysis software.
problem: Vault metadata such as tags, links, and backlinks is only accessible inside Obsidian via plugins, so external tools like launchers or graph analysis software cannot read it.

relations.evidence: Exemplary use cases are launcher apps (e.g. Alfred, Ulauncher)
Exemplary use cases are launcher apps (e.g. Alfred, Ulauncher)

summary: Metadata exporter that writes tag, note, non-Markdown file, and canvas metadata to JSON files on disk on a schedule for use by third-party apps.
